title: A statement of the learner’s purpose

priorTranscript.text: Hi. Sorry — I already told the other doctor everything last night. Is this going to take long?

currentLearnerUtterance: My goal is to help understand why you're here

should: Respond to the learner’s purpose in the ongoing conversation.
Acknowledge the invitation or briefly relate the permitted presenting concern.
mustNot: Do not treat this ordinary statement as meaningless.
Do not reveal restricted risk details merely because help was offered.
